crossRefs.note: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t…
For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

translations.web: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
translations.bsb: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
translations.asv: yet to abide in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
